title: As … as, not as … as, the same as
summary: So sánh bằng (as … as), kém hơn (not as … as), giống nhau (the same as) và khác nhau (different from).

dialogue.en: Is your new flat [[as big as]] the old one?
dialogue.vi: Căn hộ mới có rộng bằng căn cũ không?

dialogue.en: No, it's [[not as big]], but it's closer to work.
dialogue.vi: Không, không rộng bằng, nhưng gần chỗ làm hơn.

dialogue.en: Is the rent [[the same as]] before?
dialogue.vi: Tiền thuê có như trước không?

dialogue.en: Almost. It's [[as cheap as]] the old place.
dialogue.vi: Gần như vậy. Rẻ ngang chỗ cũ.

dialogue.en: Very [[different from]] my old ones. They're really quiet!
dialogue.vi: Khác hẳn hàng xóm cũ. Họ rất yên tĩnh!

sections.heading: As + tính từ + as
sections.rule: Hai bên **bằng nhau** → **as + tính từ (nguyên dạng) + as**.
body: Giữa hai chữ as là tính từ **nguyên dạng**, không thêm -er, không dùng more.

examples.en: My son is [[as tall as]] me now.
examples.vi: Con trai tôi giờ cao bằng tôi rồi.

examples.en: This bag is [[as expensive as]] that one.
examples.vi: Túi này đắt ngang túi kia.
examples.why: Tính từ dài vẫn giữ nguyên: as expensive as.

examples.en: Is Da Nang [[as hot as]] Saigon?
examples.vi: Đà Nẵng có nóng bằng Sài Gòn không?
examples.why: Câu hỏi: Is A as… as B?

check.prompt: Lan is as ___ as her sister.
check.explain: Giữa as… as dùng nguyên dạng: pretty.

sections.heading: Not as … as: không bằng
sections.rule: **not as + tính từ + as** = không… bằng (A kém hơn B).
body: *The bus isn't as fast as the train* = xe buýt không nhanh bằng tàu = tàu nhanh hơn. Đây là cách nói nhẹ nhàng, lịch sự hơn so sánh hơn.

examples.en: The bus [[isn't as fast as]] the train.
examples.vi: Xe buýt không nhanh bằng tàu.
examples.why: Not as fast as = chậm hơn.

examples.en: My English [[isn't as good as]] yours.
examples.vi: Tiếng Anh của tôi không giỏi bằng bạn.
examples.why: Cách nói khiêm tốn, lịch sự.

examples.vi: Hôm nay không lạnh bằng hôm qua.

check.prompt: This hotel isn't ___ comfortable as the last one.

sections.heading: The same as, similar to, different from
sections.rule: **the same as** = giống hệt; **similar to** = gần giống; **different from** = khác với.

examples.en: Your phone is [[the same as]] mine.
examples.vi: Điện thoại của bạn giống hệt của tôi.
examples.why: Giống hệt → the same as (có the).

examples.vi: Ý của cô ấy gần giống ý tôi.

examples.en: Life in the city is very [[different from]] life in the countryside.
examples.vi: Cuộc sống thành phố rất khác ở quê.

check.prompt: My shoes are the same ___ yours.

mistakes.wrong: She is as taller as me.
mistakes.right: She is as tall as me.
mistakes.why: Giữa as… as dùng nguyên dạng.

mistakes.wrong: It is not as cheap than the bus.
mistakes.right: It is not as cheap as the bus.
mistakes.why: Not as… as, không dùng than.

mistakes.wrong: My bag is same as yours.
mistakes.right: My bag is the same as yours.

mistakes.wrong: His car is the same like mine.
mistakes.right: His car is the same as mine.
mistakes.why: The same as, không dùng like.
Ở A2 dùng different from (than hay gặp ở Mỹ nhưng nên học from trước).

exercises.prompt: My brother is as ___ as my father.
Hanoi isn't as hot ___ Saigon in summer.
Her dress is the same ___ mine.
Câu nào cùng nghĩa với 'The train is faster than the bus'?
options: The bus isn't as fast as the train.
The train isn't as fast as the bus.
exercises.explain: Xe buýt không nhanh bằng tàu.

exercises.prompt: This exercise is ___ the last one.
My new job isn't as ___ as my old one.
Vietnamese food is very different ___ Thai food.
I'm not as ___ as you at maths.

exercises.vi: Tiếng Anh không khó bằng tiếng Nhật.
Con mèo này to bằng con chó.

exercises.sentence: My room is as bigger as yours.
answers: My room is as big as yours.
exercises.explain: Giữa as… as dùng nguyên dạng.

exercises.sentence: Today isn't as warm than yesterday.
answers: Today isn't as warm as yesterday.

exercises.sentence: Her bag is same as mine.
answers: Her bag is the same as mine.

exercises.vi: Em gái tôi cao bằng tôi.
answers: My sister is as tall as me.
My sister is as tall as I am.
My younger sister is as tall as me.
My younger sister is as tall as I am.

exercises.vi: Phim này không hay bằng cuốn sách.
answers: This film isn't as good as the book.
This film is not as good as the book.
This movie isn't as good as the book.
This movie is not as good as the book.
